summary: Addentax Group Corp. filed an 8-K on September 14, 2026, reporting a September 9, 2026 private placement agreement with non-U.S. investor Chan Chun Hong covering 520,834 common shares at $4.80 per share, roughly $2.5 million gross. The issuance relies on Regulation S, with restricted legends and closing subject to customary conditions. Proceeds are earmarked for general corporate purposes, working capital and potential strategic investments. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or regulatory clock is disclosed. This is an ordinary exempt capital raise, not a special situation; watch for pricing pressure from the discount and any strategic-investment follow-through.
